auditor_martin: Hi team — auditor here. We're preparing the control workbook for key/certificate rotation and RBAC change detection. Can you provide a concise list of artifacts showing service principal rotation, rolebinding change alerts, and the incident triage for CVE-2025-XXXX?

maria.sec: Sure. High level: we have KMS key rotation logs (CloudKMS API), KMS policy snapshots, AWS CloudTrail events for CreateKey/RotateKey, and a signed rotation manifest in s3://redwood-compliance/rotations/2025/.

auditor_martin: Perfect. For RBAC, auditor requests proof that unexpected RoleBinding edits trigger an alert and a playbook run. Where do you capture that?

sam-eng: We ingest k8s audit logs into our ELK. Rule: if rolebinding.modified_by != allowed_admins list -> create security.alert.rbac_change and trigger PagerDuty.

sam-eng: Example detection query (Elasticsearch):
```
index:k8s-audit event.objectRef.resource:rolebindings AND NOT actor.sub:'serviceAccount:infra:rbac-approver'
```

lee-oncall: The alert pipeline attaches the audit payload and a presigned link to the kube-audit snapshot to the ticket. Tickets are auto-tagged incident:rbac and run the RBAC playbook.

auditor_martin: Can you produce one sample ticket and the corresponding evidence bundle? Auditor wants chain-of-custody and timestamps.

dana-iam: I can export an anonymized bundle. It will include CloudTrail event JSON, k8s audit snippet, the PagerDuty incident ID, the ticket timeline, and the rolebinding YAML prior/after. Manifest will include SHA256 hashes and who signed it.

auditor_martin: How do you prove the service principal rotated keys? We need to know rotation windows and who approved it.

maria.sec: Rotation workflow: scheduled rotation every 90 days for infra service principals. Approval flows through IAM-console with ABAC tag "rotation:approved" and a recorded approver in the audit entry. For KMS keys we also store keyVersion metadata. Example CloudTrail event: "RotateKey" with requestParameters.keyId and userIdentity. We attach the keyVersion snapshot from KMS and the signed manifest from ops (GPG sig).

sam-eng: For on-prem KMS we keep HSM audit and a rotation ticket in JIRA with a checklist. We can export the ticket PDF as part of the artifact bundle.

auditor_martin: For CVE triage — provide timeline showing detection -> triage -> mitigation -> post-mortem. What artifacts?

lee-oncall: Timeline artifacts: Alert ID, initial detection log, vuln triage notes (triage doc link), mitigation PR and deploy rollout logs, and postmortem draft. Example: detection 2025-02-03T11:04Z (IDS alert), triage started 2025-02-03T11:10Z, mitigation PR merged 2025-02-03T13:02Z, canary rollback 2025-02-03T14:20Z, postmortem published 2025-02-10.

auditor_martin: For SOC2 mapping — which controls cover these artifacts? Need mapping table entries.

maria.sec: Map to CC6.1 (change management), CC7.2 (logical access), CC8.3 (monitoring & alerting). We'll attach a CSV with control_id, artifact_path, responsible_owner, and retention policy.

auditor_martin: Good. A few practical asks: 1) How to generate the signed rotation manifest? 2) How to pull a redaction-friendly k8s audit snippet? 3) One anonymized sample ticket.

dana-iam: 1) Signed manifest: ops-runner produces JSON manifest and signs with our ops GPG key. Command: `./ops-runner rotation manifest --key-id K-1234 --out manifest.json && gpg --output manifest.json.sig --detach-sign manifest.json`. We store both files in S3 with server-side encryption.

dana-iam: 2) Redaction snippet: run `kubectl audit-ev --start=2025-02-03T10:50Z --end=2025-02-03T11:20Z | jq 'del(.requestObject.user.email, .requestObject.headers, .userAgent)' > audit_snippet.json`

sam-eng: 3) I'll attach one anonymized ticket exported as PDF and the PagerDuty timeline (redacted). Expect a link and zip by EOD.

auditor_martin: Thanks — also any objections if we request a Splunk snapshot for 30 days around the incident?

maria.sec: No objections. We maintain 90-day hot logs for audits. Provide Splunk query and we can generate a snapshot with hashed filenames.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: RBAC-fix rollout: canary -> 2/3 -> global. status: succeeded. :white_check_mark:

auditor_martin: Great, please post the artifact bundle link when ready. We'll review the manifest and mapping CSV and follow up with one technical control question.

maria.sec: Will do — uploading to s3://redwood-audits/audits/2025/Q1/martin_bundle_6135792001.zip and will DM the presigned link.

auditor_martin: Received, thanks. Closing for now, will reopen if we need clarifications. :handshake:
